doc.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His own practice habits
summary: He did not practice much; he changed keys to stay fresh.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: What was your practice routine like?
I’m talking about then, the ‘40s, the ‘50s...

I was working a lot then. I didn’t have no practice routine. When I started playing a lot, I never practiced, because I’d just go to work. If I got tired of playing a song, I just played it another key or something like that. Keep myself fresh. It made me think about what I’m doing.
